summary: Client for the embedder daemon used by hooks, keeper and CLI: request() never throws and resolves null past connectMs+budgetMs (so the real ceiling is their SUM), and refuses a Unix socket or socket dir owned by another uid (never sends texts to an impostor); embedTexts returns decoded Float32Arrays or null; ensureEmbedder spawns the daemon detached behind ~/.coldstart/embedder/spawn.lock (60 s stale takeover), asks an older-PROTOCOL daemon to stop first, and returns 'cooldown' for 10 min after a daemon recorded model.failedAt in state.json; notifyEmbedder registers the repo then pings or spawns. embedderDisabled() gates everything and is OPT-IN for now (needs COLDSTART_EMBEDDER=1 or the enabled flag; =0 or the disabled flag always win).

summary: Client side of the embedder daemon: request never throws and never exceeds connectMs+budgetMs (null on any failure), refuses a socket owned by another uid. Two gates: embedderOff() = explicit kill switch (COLDSTART_EMBEDDER=0 or the disabled flag), embedderDisabled() = off OR not opted in; ensureEmbedder/notifyEmbedder take optIn (default true) and the recall gate passes optIn:false. repoCacheDir(root) reads the keeper's registration file for the cache dir, else defaultRepoCacheDir. waitForEmbedder(ms) polls ping until model==='ready'.

summary: Client side of the embedder daemon: request never throws and never exceeds connectMs+budgetMs (null on any failure), refuses a socket owned by another uid. Two gates: embedderOff() = explicit kill switch (COLDSTART_EMBEDDER=0 or the disabled flag), embedderDisabled() = off OR not opted in; ensureEmbedder/notifyEmbedder take optIn (default true) and the recall gate passes optIn:false. repoCacheDir(root) reads the keeper's registration file for the cache dir, else defaultRepoCacheDir. waitForEmbedder(ms) polls ping until model==='ready'. Old daemon kept serving after an update (fixed 2026-11-22): ensureEmbedder's protocol check only runs when the daemon does NOT answer, so a working older-protocol daemon was never replaced until its ~90-min idle exit. Now every daemon reply carries `protocol` (a protocol-1 daemon sends it only on ping → missing = 0) and embedTexts/notifyEmbedder call replaceIfOlder: on an older reply it spawns a new daemon detached via spawnDaemon (spawn lock + 10-min model-failure cooldown; once per process, survives the hook's exit) and still uses that reply; the new daemon's listen() stops the old one and takes the socket. Never replaces a same or newer protocol. Verified live: protocol-1 daemon (527 MB) replaced by protocol 2 (243 MB) on one query, store untouched; pinned by tests/embed-client-upgrade.test.ts (fails on the old client).
